fields.title: Number of rows before the header
fields.description: Number of rows in the input table that precede the row that should be used as new column header

fields.title: Discard rows before header row
fields.description: Whether rows before the row containing the new column header should be discarded. Otherwise they are treated as additional output rows.

fields.title: Detect types of resulting columns
fields.description: Whether type analysis should be applied to the output table. For each column, the most specific of the four column types double (64-bit floating-point number), long (64-bit integral number), int (32-bit integral number) and String is determined and the column is converted to this type.
